title: Provenance audit for the nine-climate fixed-reference experiment

scope.simulation_change: This record documents the already-used fixed-reference inputs. The control interface was applied consistently to every run, including release of three source-model maximum-outdoor-air EMS overrides; geometry, envelope, internal loads, nominal outdoor-air requirements and HVAC topology were retained.

existing_source_manifest_crosswalk.S06: DOE/PNNL ASHRAE 90.1-2019 Medium Office prototype archive
existing_source_manifest_crosswalk.coverage_added_here: The remaining seven weather files and the extracted/fixed IDF hashes are recorded in this provenance record without modifying the locked source manifest.

weather_metadata.header_interpretation: City, source, station identifier, latitude, longitude, time zone and elevation were read from each EPW LOCATION record according to the EnergyPlus EPW data dictionary.
weather_metadata.climate_zone_reference: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 169-2020 addendum a, station tables A-3, A-5 and A-6

Malmo.basis: MALMO WMO 026350 and MALMO AP WMO 026360 are both 5A in Standard 169.

Tunis.basis: TUNIS CARTHAGE WMO 607150 is 2A in Standard 169.

Sydney.basis: SYDNEY AP WMO 947670 is 3A in Standard 169.

download_verification.malmo: The local PVGIS 5.2 ERA5 EPW header and filename identify the 2005-2020 acquisition, and its fixed local SHA256 is recorded. The API output is dynamically served, so reproducibility is anchored to the recorded input hash.
download_verification.raw_file_policy: Raw EPW files are local inputs and are not tracked in the code repository. The CSV records reacquisition URLs, attributions and immutable local hashes.

prototype.official_archive_rights_note: Public review and use are stated by DOE; an explicit redistribution licence for the archive was not located. The repository records the URL and hash rather than redistributing the archive.
prototype.floor_area_evidence: An EnergyPlus 22.1 eplusout.eio generated from the fixed reference reports 18 zones. The 15 zones marked Part of Total Building Area=Yes sum to 4982.19 m2; three plenum zones are excluded.
prototype.official_description: The DOE/PNNL scorecard describes the medium office as 53,628 ft2 with packaged variable-air-volume HVAC and electric terminal reheat.

thermostat_deadband_evidence.basis: The experiment preserves the 3.0 C occupied heating-to-cooling separation in the official Medium Office IDF while translating its midpoint to each tested control target.
thermostat_deadband_evidence.interpretation: This is an equipment-control deadband inherited from the prototype schedule, not a claimed human perceptual or acceptable-temperature band.

comparison_with_official_idf.declared_difference: The fixed reference retains the DOE geometry and HVAC system but is not the untouched DOE file. It adds 30 zone-level setpoint schedules and actuators, output requests and SQLite reporting, and changes the occupied thermostat schedules used by the experiment's control interface.

ventilation_control_adaptation.change: Three DOE maximum-outdoor-air EMS override actuators were released with NULL in every climate and controller while the native DesignSpecification:OutdoorAir objects and nominal ventilation requirements were retained.
ventilation_control_adaptation.basis: The common adaptation is documented and checked by src/utilities/audit_ventilation_adaptation.py against the declared ventilation-delivery and hourly outdoor-air/supply-flow gates.
ventilation_control_adaptation.interpretation: This is a shared pre-control implementation choice, not a controller-specific treatment or a ventilation standard.

prototype.active_run_check: All nine records in the final run manifest identify prototype_mode=fixed_reference and the same fixed-reference SHA256.
prototype.legacy_configuration_note: The prototype_variant strings retained in src/analysis/global_extension/GLOBAL_CLIMATES.json are historical labels and are ignored by the final fixed-reference preparation path. The MODEL_MANIFEST above is authoritative for the building actually simulated.
